title: pdfsys.page/2
description: L2 publish format. The row unit is the PAGE, keyed (doc_id, page_index) — an identity the PDF gives us rather than one a layout model invents. Three Parquet tables: `pages` (required), `images` (unique figure crops, content-addressed) and `page_images` (full-page rasters). `images` and `page_images` are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE by build mode: MinerU's crops are already sub-rectangles of a 200-dpi page render, so populating both stores the same pixels twice. The image/text interleaving is encoded inline in `pages.text`, so the interleaved and pair views survive a shard written without `blocks`. Canonical implementation: pdfsys_core.dataset + pdfsys_cli.dataset_writer.

BlockType.title: BlockType
BlockType.description: Block-level classification. The four furniture types (page_header, page_footer, page_number, aside) are page decoration and are excluded from the rendered `text` by default.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: Normalized bounding box, [0, 1], top-left origin, y down. Null when the source coordinates could not be rescaled — an absent bbox is honest, a wrong one silently corrupts every downstream crop. In `pages` mode this doubles as the image's address, so a block whose bbox could not be normalized keeps its crop blob instead.

ImageBytes.title: ImageBytes
ImageBytes.description: HuggingFace `datasets.Image` wire struct. Decodes via cast_column("image", Image()) with no conversion.

path.description: `<image_id>.<format>`; informational only — images are addressed by content.

Block.title: Block
Block.description: One block-level unit in document reading order — the model-derived rung of the format. `page` is deliberately absent: it would be a constant per row, equal to the page's page_index.

idx.description: Reading-order index scoped to the DOCUMENT, not the page, so that `mentions` can point across a page break. Dense over the document.

text.description: Content. Encoding follows the Segment contract: text/title/list = Markdown, table = HTML, formula = LaTeX, code = source text. Null for image/chart, whose pixels live in `image_id`.

level.description: Heading level for `title` blocks; null otherwise.

caption.description: Human-authored caption attached to an image / chart / table. Multiple caption lines are newline-joined.

footnote.description: Footnote attached to an image / chart / table.

alt.description: Model-generated description of the image (MinerU VLM output). Kept separate from `caption` so a consumer can choose ground truth over synthetic text, and never rendered into `text`.

image_id.description: SHA-256 of a stored crop; join key into the images table. Null in `pages` mode, where `bbox` is the address: crop the page raster at those coordinates. Also null for blocks that carry no image.

mentions.description: `idx` of blocks in the same DOCUMENT whose text references this figure/table by label ("as shown in Fig. 3"). May point at a block on another page, so resolving it means reading the sibling page rows.

Page.title: Page
Page.description: One row of the pages table — one page of one PDF.

doc_id.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source PDF bytes. Same identity as ExtractedDoc.sha256. Together with page_index this is the row key — both come from the PDF, neither from a model.

page_index.description: Zero-based page number within the source PDF.

width_pt.description: Page width in PDF points (1/72 inch), as the PDF declares it. 612x792 is US Letter, 595x842 is A4.

rotation.description: Page rotation in degrees as declared by the PDF.

text.description: The page rendered as Markdown. Figures appear as one of two inline markers: `![](img://<image_id>)` when a crop is stored in the images table, or `![](bbox://x0,y0,x1,y1)` when the pixels are to be cut out of this page's raster instead. The caption follows as its own paragraph. THIS STRING CARRIES THE INTERLEAVING: splitting it on the marker yields the image/text sequence without reading `blocks`, and a region marker is self-contained because the row already supplies doc_id, page_index and page_image_id.

image_ids.description: Image crops referenced by this page, in first-use order. Empty in `pages` mode, where figures are addressed by bbox against the page raster instead. Denormalized so a join can be planned without reading the nested column.

page_image_id.description: Full-page raster, joining the page_images table. Null unless the shard was built with `--images pages`. Rasters are reproducible from the source PDF at any DPI, which is why they are not built by default.

render_dpi.description: DPI the page raster was rendered at. Null when there is none.

blocks.description: Model-derived block structure. Null when the shard was written with --no-blocks. Dropping it costs bboxes, captions, block types and mention links — never the interleaving, which lives in `text`.

extractor.description: Which backend produced the text: mupdf | pipeline | vlm.

layout_model.description: Layout model tag that produced `blocks`, e.g. pp-doclayoutv3@1.0. The versioning handle for everything in that column.

n_blocks.description: Block count. Populated even when `blocks` is null.

n_images.description: Count of image + chart blocks on this page.

n_tables.description: Count of table blocks on this page.

n_formulas.description: Count of formula blocks on this page.

lang.description: Language of this page. Null until a per-page identifier fills it.

quality_score.description: Per-page OCR quality, [0, 3]. Null until a per-page scorer fills it — deliberately not backfilled from the document score, which would misreport a whole book's average as every page's.

quality_model.description: Model that produced the quality score.

doc_n_pages.description: Total pages in the source document.

provenance.description: Opaque upstream JSON (license, crawl batch, policy tier). Not parsed by pdfsys.

doc_lang.description: Document-level language, denormalized onto every page.

doc_quality_score.description: Document-level OCR quality, denormalized onto every page.

router_ocr_prob.description: Stage-A router P(needs OCR) for the document.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: One row of the images table — one unique image crop per shard. Content addressing dedupes the letterheads and stamps that repeat across a scanned corpus.

width.description: Pixel width; 0 when the header could not be parsed.

height.description: Pixel height; 0 when the header could not be parsed.

PageImage.title: PageImage
PageImage.description: One row of the page_images table — a full-page raster. Kept out of `images` because a 200-dpi page is one to two orders of magnitude larger than a crop, and because the whole table can be built later, or never, without rewriting anything else.

doc_id.description: Document this page raster belongs to.

render_dpi.description: Resolution it was rendered at. A page may legitimately appear at several.

width.description: Pixel width; 0 when the header could not be parsed.

height.description: Pixel height; 0 when the header could not be parsed.

Pair.title: Pair
Pair.description: One row of the optional materialized image-text pair view. Derived from pages.blocks; never a source of truth. The image is addressed either by image_id (a stored crop) or by bbox (a rectangle of this page's raster).

image_id.description: Join key into the images table when a crop is stored. Null in `pages` mode, where `bbox` addresses the pixels instead. Exactly one of image_id / bbox is set.

block_idx.description: Document-scoped index of the block the image belongs to.

source.description: Which tier supplied the text, best first: content (caption + the block's own transcription, e.g. a table crop with its HTML), caption (human ground truth), alt (model-generated), mention (body text referencing the figure by label, possibly from another page), context (adjacent text blocks).
